verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs describe organization-level defaults that apply to all connected repositories, with repository-level settings that override them. Both levels are managed from a central Configurations page in the portal, or as code via .pr_agent.toml at repo, project, group or org level. Governance is pitched at enforcing consistent standards across every repository at scale. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of rollout across hundreds of repos, and documentation of how exceptions are tracked or audited centrally (e.g., a view of which repos override defaults).
